sloka: तदेवं प्राञ्जलिः प्रह्वो याचते त्वां दशाननः ।भर्तुर्भर्ता विधाता च त्रैलोक्यस्य भजस्व माम् ।। ७.२६.२८ ॥
transliteration: tadevaṁ prāñjaliḥ prahvo yācate tvāṁ daśānanaḥ ।bharturbhartā vidhātā ca trailokyasya bhajasva mām ।। 7.26.28 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, the ten-headed Ravana, bowing down with folded hands, begs you, "Worship me, for I am the lord of lords and the creator of the three worlds."
